places.name: Age.3 Asakusa
places.order: Fried cream sando (whipped cream or crème brûlée)
places.arrive: 10:00 at opening, or mid-afternoon to skip the line
places.notes: Each sando is fried to order. Whipped cream from about ¥400.
places.addressJa: 東京都台東区浅草2-7-22
places.about: Tiny stand frying brioche sandwiches filled with whipped cream or custard – crisp outside, cold cream inside. Takeaway snack, eat on the street nearby.

places.name: Wagyu Don Ohno (Roast Beef Ohno) Kamakura
places.arrive: 11:00 for lunch – pairs with a Kamakura day trip
places.notes: Day trip from Tokyo (about 1 h by JR Yokosuka Line).
places.addressJa: 神奈川県鎌倉市小町2-2-16
places.about: Rare roast-beef bowl piled high with thin wagyu slices and a raw yolk, on Komachi-dori shopping street by Kamakura Station. Easy lunch on a Kamakura day trip.

places.name: RAMEN Mozu
places.notes: Directly connected to Akasaka Station (Chiyoda Line). Counter only.
places.addressEn: Akasaka Biz Tower B1F, 5-3-1 Akasaka, Minato-ku, Tokyo
places.addressJa: 東京都港区赤坂5-3-1 赤坂Bizタワー B1F
places.about: Clear, light chicken-salt ramen in an office-tower basement food floor – quick counter meal, good near Akasaka hotels.

places.name: Sushi Yoshikawa
places.notes: The post says Roppongi; the branch serving the Dragon Ball roll that I could confirm is in Azabu-Juban (next to Roppongi). Confirm the branch when booking.
places.addressEn: Azabu-Juban, Minato-ku, Tokyo (confirm branch when booking)
places.about: Creative sushi counter known for the "Dragon Ball" roll – fatty tuna and sea urchin rolled into a sphere. Course-only dinner.

places.name: Tonkatsu Marushichi
places.notes: Cash or PayPay at the main shop. Exact Ginza address not confirmed – pin is approximate; the Monzen-Nakacho main shop is the safe bet.
places.about: Huge, thick pork-cutlet rice bowl simmered in egg and dashi – a heavy, old-school lunch. Pork only.

places.name: KITAN HIBIKI
places.hours: Burgers served at lunch; evening is a dry-aged steak restaurant
places.notes: About 5 min walk from Namba Station. Evening steak course runs ¥8,000–10,000.
places.addressJa: 大阪府大阪市中央区難波1-1-7
places.bookingHow: Seat reservation on the restaurant's booking page
places.about: Dry-aged wagyu burger with a crispy potato layer, near Dotonbori. Evenings it turns into a steak restaurant.

places.name: Sushi L'Abysse Osaka
places.order: Omakase – go for the 17:30 sunset seating
places.notes: Yannick Alléno's sushi counter. Not kosher; no-pork / no-shellfish adjustments only if requested when booking. Drinks extra.
places.addressEn: Four Seasons Hotel Osaka 37F, Dojima 2-chome, Kita-ku, Osaka
places.addressJa: 大阪府大阪市北区堂島2丁目 フォーシーズンズホテル大阪 37階
places.about: Yannick Alléno's omakase sushi counter on the 37th floor with city views. The 17:30 sunset seating is the cheaper and more scenic slot. Not kosher; no-pork/no-shellfish on request when booking.

places.name: Benitsuru
places.arrive: 8:30 – same-day numbered tickets handed out at the door (¥1,000 deposit)
places.notes: A few minutes from Tawaramachi Station; 5 min from Tsukuba Express Asakusa. Cards accepted.
places.addressJa: 東京都台東区西浅草2-1-11
places.bookingHow: Same-day numbered ticket at the door from 8:30 (¥1,000 deposit) – no online booking
places.about: Famous soufflé-style triple-stack pancakes (the bacon-and-egg one is the signature). Tickets for the day sell out early – go at 8:30 to get a slot.

photos.credit: Brian Jeffery Beggerly from S'pore (Singapore), Singapore

places.name: T Nakameguro
places.arrive: On time – the course starts for everyone together
places.notes: Ranked among the world's best steak restaurants. Business-casual dress.
places.addressJa: 東京都目黒区上目黒2-37-12 コンフォート中目黒102
places.about: Steak tasting course built around a huge Omi-beef T-bone. Everyone starts at the same time – arrive on the minute.

places.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
places.order: Tamagoyaki, tuna, uni and grilled seafood stalls
places.days: Many stalls close Sundays, holidays and some Wednesdays
places.notes: Combine with Ginza (10 min walk). Eat at the stall, not while walking.
places.addressJa: 東京都中央区築地4丁目 築地場外市場
places.about: Old outer market streets with stalls selling tamagoyaki, tuna, uni, grilled scallops and knives. Graze from stall to stall in the morning; many close by early afternoon.

places.name: Yagura
places.notes: Opened 1971. 7 min walk from Gion Station.
places.addressJa: 福岡県福岡市博多区博多駅前2-9-28 B1
places.about: 50-year-old basement counter where the old chef makes katsudon in front of you; add the udon set. Lunch crowd of office workers.

places.name: Ginza Kagari (main shop)
places.notes: 5 min from Ginza Station.
places.addressJa: 東京都中央区銀座6-4-12
places.about: Creamy chicken paitan ramen – rich, silky broth, the dish that made this tiny alley shop famous. Expect a line.

places.name: Kappo Shishikura
places.notes: Bowls ¥8,000; tuna + uni "Emperor" bowl ¥18,000. Pin is at Ebisu Station area – exact address to confirm.
places.addressEn: Ebisu, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo (exact address: check booking page)
places.about: Premium bluefin tuna bowls (lean, medium-fatty and fatty in one bowl), plus a tuna-and-uni "Emperor" bowl.

places.name: Maguro Mart
places.order: Maguro Mart platter + nakaochi (scrape tuna off the bone)
places.notes: Hours differ between the post (Mon–Fri 17–22, Sat–Sun 16–23) and OpenStreetMap (Mon–Sat 17–24, Sun 16–23:30). Confirm when booking.
places.addressEn: Arai 1-chome (Yakushi Ai-Road shopping street), Nakano-ku, Tokyo
places.addressJa: 東京都中野区新井1丁目 薬師あいロード商店街 マグロマート
places.bookingHow: Phone or online; book about a month ahead
places.about: Small tuna-only restaurant with rare cuts you rarely see elsewhere – scraped bone meat (nakaochi), seasonal chef specials.

places.name: Yurakucho Kakida
places.notes: About ¥12,000–13,000 + one drink minimum (¥1,000+). 3 min from Shinjuku South Exit. The post tagged it as a buffet "5 min from Shinjuku".
places.addressEn: Odakyu Southern Tower 19F, 2-2-1 Yoyogi, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
places.addressJa: 東京都渋谷区代々木2-2-1 小田急サザンタワー19階
places.bookingHow: Online – seatings often full months ahead
places.about: All-you-can-eat omakase sushi with Toyosu-market fish, served in timed seatings. A one-drink minimum applies.

places.name: Yatai Ramen Shunyacchan
places.order: Hachioji-style shoyu ramen with chopped onion
places.arrive: After a Mt. Takao hike, from opening
places.notes: Street-stall style ramen far west of central Tokyo – pair it with a Mt. Takao day.
places.addressJa: 東京都八王子市初沢町 屋台ラーメン しゅんやっちゃん
places.about: Street-stall style ramen with Hachioji's chopped-onion shoyu soup. Far west of central Tokyo – combine with a Mt. Takao hike.

places.name: Ikura (Hamburger & Omurice)
places.order: Omurice + hamburg steak on the hot plate
places.arrive: Opening time – there is usually a line
places.notes: Live teppan cooking at the counter.
places.addressJa: 東京都渋谷区道玄坂1丁目 いくら
places.about: Omurice and hamburg steak cooked on a sizzling hot plate in front of you – fun, filling, casual.

places.name: Godaime Hanayama Udon (Ginza)
places.notes: Shorter line at the Nihonbashi branch.
places.addressJa: 東京都中央区銀座3-14-13
places.about: Gunma-style "himokawa" udon – noodles as wide as a ribbon, served hot or cold. Long queues at the Ginza branch.

places.name: Harajuku Gyoza Ro
places.notes: Two-item menu, very cheap. Combine with Cat Street.
places.addressJa: 東京都渋谷区神宮前6-2-4
places.about: Cheap, fast gyoza – pan-fried or steamed, with or without garlic – a classic quick stop between Harajuku shops.

places.name: Hikiniku to Come Kyoto
places.notes: Registration is not a seat guarantee – expect some wait. Also in Shibuya and Kichijoji (Tokyo).
places.addressJa: 京都府京都市東山区清本町363
places.bookingHow: Free online slots 7 days ahead, or same-day registration in store from 9:00
places.about: Hamburg steaks grilled over charcoal and served one at a time, straight to your rice bowl. Strict time slots.

places.name: BAR CENTIFOLIA
places.arrive: 20:30 at opening for walk-ins; late 00:00–02:00 slots are kept for walk-ins
places.notes: The post says closed only Wednesdays – the bar's own booking page now says Wednesdays and Sundays.
places.addressJa: 東京都港区麻布十番1丁目 バー センティフォリア
places.about: Theatrical cocktail bar where drinks arrive like performances, with a welcome glass of champagne. Popular with visitors – book or arrive at opening.

photos.credit: No machine-readable author provided. BetacommandBot assumed

places.name: Ine Funaya fishing village
places.hours: Village always open; boat tours about 9:00–16:00
places.arrive: Morning, to stay into late afternoon light
places.time: Half day (+2 h drive each way)
places.notes: About 2 h from Kyoto or Osaka. Rental car is the easiest – needs an International Driving Permit.
places.addressJa: 京都府与謝郡伊根町日出
places.about: Fishing village of wooden boathouses (funaya) built right on the water. Quiet, scenic, best seen from the short sightseeing boat.

places.name: Arakurayama Sengen Park – Chureito Pagoda
places.arrive: Sunrise to 8:00 – Fuji hides in cloud later
places.season: Late Mar–early Apr cherry blossoms; winter clearest Fuji
places.notes: Fuji is fully visible only around 80 days a year – check the forecast.
places.addressJa: 山梨県富士吉田市新倉 忠霊塔
places.about: The postcard view: a five-storey red pagoda in front of Mt. Fuji, reached by 398 steps. Clear mornings are everything here.

places.name: Fuji-Q Highland – Naruto × Boruto village
places.notes: Ichiraku ramen and character meet-ups in the Naruto area. Pairs with Chureito Pagoda (10 min away). Confirm the Naruto area is still running before going.
places.addressJa: 山梨県富士吉田市新西原5-6-1 富士急ハイランド
places.about: Big thrill-ride park at the foot of Fuji with a Naruto/Boruto "Hidden Leaf Village" area – character meets, Ichiraku ramen, anime props.

places.name: Nijigen no Mori – NARUTO & BORUTO Shinobi-Zato
places.notes: Express bus "Kakehashi Naruto" from Osaka/Kobe. No filming during the finale.
places.addressJa: 兵庫県淡路市楠本 ニジゲンノモリ
places.about: Outdoor Naruto ninja park on Awaji Island: complete missions by performing jutsu hand signs that sensors recognise to open doors and chests.

places.name: Matsumoto Castle
places.season: All year; cherry blossom early–mid April
places.notes: Part of the 5-day Alps route from the post: Matsumoto ×2 nights, then Takayama ×2.
places.addressJa: 長野県松本市丸の内4-1 松本城
places.about: One of Japan's few original castles – black "crow castle" with steep wooden stairs inside. Climb to the top for Alps views.

places.name: Daio Wasabi Farm
places.notes: Try the wasabi soft-serve.
places.addressJa: 長野県安曇野市穂高 大王わさび農場
places.about: Huge wasabi farm with crystal-clear spring-water channels and old water wheels. Free to walk; try the wasabi soft-serve.

places.name: Nakasendo trail – Magome to Tsumago
places.notes: Start in Magome – mostly downhill toward Tsumago.
places.addressJa: 岐阜県中津川市馬籠 馬籠宿
places.about: Walk the preserved Edo-era post road between two old wooden post towns through forest and waterfalls – about 8 km, mostly downhill from Magome.

places.name: Kamikochi
places.hours: Buses from early morning; last buses out late afternoon
places.season: Mid-Apr to mid-Nov only; autumn colours mid-Oct
places.notes: Closed in winter – plan the Alps leg between April and November.
places.addressJa: 長野県松本市安曇 上高地 河童橋
places.about: Alpine valley with a turquoise river and the Hotaka peaks. Flat riverside walks from Kappa Bridge – no private cars, bus or taxi only.

places.name: Takayama old town (Sanmachi-suji)
places.season: All year; festivals mid-April and early October
places.notes: Try Hida beef sushi. The post suggests a relaxing hotel here.
places.addressJa: 岐阜県高山市上三之町
places.about: Lanes of dark wooden merchant houses, sake breweries and Hida-beef snack stalls, plus riverside morning markets.

photos.credit: Maarten Heerlien from Voorschoten, The Netherlands
Maarten Heerlien from Voorschoten, The Netherlands

places.name: Beppu – Hells (Jigoku) & onsen town
places.notes: From the idan_gigi post – he offers Google Maps locations on request. Tattoo rules vary by bath.
places.addressJa: 大分県別府市鉄輪 海地獄
places.about: Steaming "hells" – boiling cobalt-blue and blood-red hot-spring pools – plus endless public baths in Japan's hot-spring capital.

places.name: Senso-ji & Asakusa old town
places.hours: Main hall 6:00–17:00 (from 6:30 Oct–Mar); grounds always open
places.arrive: Before 8:00 for empty photos; 10:00 for street food
places.notes: From the Tokyo first-timer post. Age.3 and Benitsuru are nearby.
places.addressJa: 東京都台東区浅草2-3-1 浅草寺
places.about: Tokyo's oldest temple: the giant red lantern gate, the Nakamise snack street and the incense-filled main hall.

places.name: Chopsticks Studio Shinjuku
places.type: Craft workshop – make your own chopsticks
places.notes: About ¥2,000; free laser engraving of a name or date; English-speaking staff.
places.addressJa: 東京都新宿区歌舞伎町1-5-4
places.about: Hands-on workshop: shape, sand and finish your own pair of chopsticks, then get them laser-engraved. A souvenir you made.

places.name: Cat Street
places.notes: From the Tokyo first-timer post.
places.addressJa: 東京都渋谷区神宮前6丁目 キャットストリート
places.about: Car-free back street between Harajuku and Shibuya lined with streetwear, vintage and concept stores.

places.name: UNIQLO Ginza flagship
places.notes: Ginza also has MUJI and other brand flagships. Combine with Tsukiji.
places.addressJa: 東京都中央区銀座6-9-5
places.about: Uniqlo's 12-floor global flagship with Japan-only lines and custom printing.

places.name: Shimokitazawa
places.notes: Young, hipster area – from the Tokyo first-timer post.
places.addressJa: 東京都世田谷区北沢2丁目 下北沢駅
places.about: Laid-back neighbourhood of vintage clothing shops, record stores, small cafés and live houses.

photos.credit: Stephen Kelly from San Francisco, CA, USA

places.name: Kichijoji & Inokashira Park
places.season: Cherry blossom late March; autumn leaves
places.notes: Few tourists. Ghibli Museum is nearby (tickets sold monthly, in advance). Hikiniku to Come has a branch here.
places.addressJa: 東京都三鷹市 井の頭恩賜公園
places.about: Leafy pond park with swan boats next to Kichijoji's shopping streets – a calm local half-day. The Ghibli Museum is a short walk.
